notes.title: Bug Fixes & Changes!
notes.notes:
Hey demon lovers, we just finished a new update fixing a lot of the issues you first time players may have had. 

-Fixed Achievements they now work!
-Voices lines repitched and adjusted with sounds
-Menu Skipping bugs removed
-Sound options bug fixed

We want to thank you the players for taking the time to tell us your worries and concerns with the game. We know not everyone is going to dig this project but a lot of hard working lewd peeps worked on it so we want it to shine as much as we can.

If you had any reservations on the game and its issues we have fixed these problems and would love a review for the game on our steam page if possible. As we are aiming for a good standing game.

I know Visual Novels are not everyones cup of tea in the Shady Corner verse but know that I think its a hot game with a lot of heart. And can promise we take down each note we get when reviewing a game, including the creator.

Thank you again for your patience :)

- Shades
